scope.rationale: D247-01 is a benchmark-only + driver-only unit: the perf-gate driver .pdca/scripts/perf/t247_json_gate.py, its stdlib unittest suite .pdca/scripts/perf/tests/test_t247_json_gate.py, and two benchmark-project files (compile-only spike arm + R247-02 ToList_Dto+JsonSerializer control). No production source (src/**) is touched, so the only executable inner-loop suite is the Python unittest driver test (the affected non-integration .NET suites are measured at the flow boundary, not here). scope.rebuild stays 'affected' because two .cs benchmark files change; the affected benchmark build is deferred to the measurement unit and no inner dotnet test runs in this unit.
